mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months (measured by 3-month change in FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines over the prior three months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, increasing recession risk and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad consumer demand weakness, triggering equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In zero lower bound regimes (FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.5%), a decline in core inflation (CPIAUCSL) signals potential monetary easing, supporting equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In zero lower bound regimes, SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where CPIAUCSL declines, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past three months indicates strengthening economic activity, supporting corporate earnings and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO increases over the prior three months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly housing starts (HOUST) below 1,200,000 units (1200.0 thousand units) signals residential sector contraction, increasing recession risk and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where HOUST is below 1200.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in non-farm payroll growth (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicate labor market deterioration, signaling recession risk and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high industrial production growth regimes (INDPRO > 105.0), a slowdown in production growth rate (month-over-month) signals potential overcapacity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In high industrial production growth regimes, SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO growth slows, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
